text:
maria: tiny design spin 12 — instead of a top-right toast for bulk-approvals, what about a compact confirmation ribbon anchored to the bottom of the window (like a snackbar) that contains the summary + Undo and a link to the regression diff. keeps context visible. kevin: figma? maria: https://www.figma.com/file/zzzz/Confirm-Ribbon-Mock (bottom ribbon). ribbon shows: 'Approved 8 prompt sets Undo View diff'. small slide-up animation. asha: accessibility first take: ribbons/snackbars are fine but same rules as toasts: role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true". do NOT move focus to the ribbon unless user tabs into it. also make the View diff link keyboard-focusable and include aria-describedby pointing to a hidden SR summary of score deltas. tom: curious about focus return on Undo or Esc. current modal flow traps focus; we must avoid that. jessica: UX note: ribbon feels less intrusive than a modal and preserves list context. keep Undo as text button (sentence case). 6s auto-dismiss but keep the ribbon reachable via keyboard until dismissed. kevin: implementation notes: we'll update the list inline, batch API calls by 50, emit analytics events approval.bulk and score.update. ribbon should show progressive counts for long ops: 'Approving 120 of 300...' until final. question: do we announce intermediate progress to SRs? asha: do NOT announce intermediate updates. only announce final completion. interim visuals are fine. final SR message should be: 'Approved 300 prompt sets. Press Undo to revert. Scorecard: 4 regressions introduced, 2 resolved.' put the scorecard sentence in a sr-only node referenced by aria-describedby. rachel: microcopy: ribbon text prefer verb-first 'Approved 8 prompt sets'. View diff label: 'View regression diff' (tooltip). Keep iconography minimal. contrast: ensure the ribbon background and CTA hit AA. kevin: will use brand-dark-green #0f7a3a for success background, white text, 3:1 contrast for the pill, and 2px focus ring for keyboard focus. maria: keyboard flow spec: focus remains where it was when approve was triggered. Tab once should reach the ribbon Undo, Tab again reaches View diff, Esc should dismiss ribbon and return focus to the previous element (bulk toolbar or the row). if Undo pressed, perform revert and announce 'Reverted X prompt sets.' asha: SR test steps to include in PR: (1) select items, (2) trigger approve, (3) assert SR reads final message in sr-only node 'Approved X prompt sets. Press Undo to revert.', (4) Tab to Undo -> Enter -> assert SR reads 'Reverted X prompt sets.', (5) trigger and press Esc -> ensure SR does not lose context and focus returns to toolbar. include VoiceOver/NVDA smoke steps. kevin: I'll add unit + e2e tests for focus behavior, NVDA/VoiceOver smoke test, and analytics assertions. will add snippet for sr-only node: ```html
Approved 8 prompt sets. Scorecard updated: 4 regressions introduced, 1 resolved. Press Undo to revert.
``` tom: acceptance criteria: 1) ribbon announced via aria-live role=status; 2) ribbon does not trap focus; 3) Undo is keyboard accessible; 4) View diff is focusable and opens diff panel; 5) analytics events for approval.bulk and score.update; 6) progressive visual counters allowed but final SR announce only; 7) color/contrast and focus styles meet AA. ui-bot: Added design token update request for success-ribbon to the design backlog. deploy-bot: UAT deployed at feature/compact-confirmation-ribbon for testing. maria: great. assigning @kevin to implement, @asha to write SR acceptance tests, @jessica to polish visuals. will review after UAT smoke pass. thanks! :sparkles:
